title: Muse
tagline: At a recent hackathon event At a recent hackathon event, I developed a novel solution
description:
At a recent hackathon event, I developed a novel solution leveraging frame-based technology to facilitate users in listening to and receiving song recommendations, particularly focusing on Muse's "Supermassive Black Hole." This project integrates frame technology with music streaming services to create an immersive experience for users.

Utilizing frame technology, the system analyses user preferences, behavior patterns, and contextual cues to offer personalized song recommendations. By understanding the dynamics of a user's listening habits, the system suggests tracks similar to "Supermassive Black Hole" by Muse, ensuring a tailored and engaging music experience.

The project not only enables users to enjoy their favorite tracks but also enhances their music discovery journey by introducing them to relevant songs based on their interests. Through this innovative fusion of frame technology and music streaming, the project aims to redefine how users interact with and explore music, providing a seamless and enjoyable listening experience.
